content.text:
-    Maintain a professional setting.
    -    Always stay on topic, if you are having some difficulties please message another exec to
         take over or help
    -    Go off of the script if you want
    -    Message other execs (hr people) through the script OR through the Zoom chat
    -    Have our email open and regularly check
    -    Whenever you ask the tutors a question or relay to get examples please type the
         question you are asking in chat.
    -    If it is your turn to talk and some people don’t have their cameras on, please remind
         them to turn it on.
    -    If you do not know/are unsure of the answer to a question, relay it to the HR manager.

content.text:
-    If you see that everyone is distracted try to change your script/slide into a discussion
         question
             -    If the session has been over an hour you can also initiate a 5-minute break
                  (preferably not anywhere near the Kahoot/another discussion pause)
    -    If your fellow exec is muted but talking, please just unmute and let them know (this goes
         for all attendees as well)
    -    Try to have a fun/engaging tone. If the script information seems unnecessary (PLEASE
         CHECK/COMMUNICATE THIS BEFORE HAND) let the HR manager know and skip the
         part.
    -    If there are extra notes that you would like to mention please do it during your slide OR
         type it in the chat.
             -    If you want to say something but are unsure if the information is reliable or
                  necessary, please communicate it to the rest of your hr team/ hr manager.
             -    Ex. Just to add onto what [ ] has said about the ___ slide/section…
    -    You can also stop and ask for questions/concerns at any time if you judge that people
         look confused or uninterested.
